measurement.name: Portugal Current
measurement.width_metric_label: Published local section span; flow-normal and whole-current widths unknown
measurement.range_interpretation: Nominal span calculated from source coordinates, not a source-reported kilometre width or physical uncertainty interval.
measurement.geographic_scope: ORCA northern section at37 N, Portugal band between14.8 and13.5 W, stations19-23.
measurement.section_orientation: Nominal zonal source section; local flow obliquity and ship track not reconstructed.
measurement.layer: Surface/thermocline flow, neutral-density layers1-4; gamma_n upper bound27.3800 kg/m3. No fixed metre slab.
measurement.time_convention: Fall2009.15 October-11 November bounds the cruise, not exact occupation days of this band.
measurement.boundary_rule: Published current-band coordinate limits; no independently digitized velocity cutoff or physical edge.
measurement.source_citation: Perez-Hernandez et al. (2013), The source of the Canary current in fall2009, JGR Oceans118,2874-2891.
measurement.source_locator: Abstract; section6 paragraph32 and Figure14a; Table1; section7 paragraph40; section2 paragraph7.
measurement.extraction_method: WGS84 inverse geodesic between previously curated source limits; display rounded to nearest kilometre. No figure digitization.
measurement.source_quality_note: Source coordinate precision, datum, exact section dates, physical edges and obliquity remain unresolved. Cruise envelope is context only.

source_event.name: Portugal Current
source_event.time_detail: The dates bound the entire ORCA cruise; the exact occupation dates of this current band are not separately assigned here.
source_event.spatial_basis: The paper reports the Portugal Current between 14.8°W and 13.5°W along its 37°N section. This is a cross-stream band, not an along-current trace.
source_event.state_boundary_limit: The reported cross-stream band intersects the approximate NAST E polygon; the state boundary and observed current extent are not surveyed together.
